parts.text: 山海已过，诗意未尽。|且循顶部栏，重读原诗，细看研习、字句赏析与行游小记。|再将所见所感，写入百川归卷，让这一程，真正落回心中。

The journey ends, but the reading continues. | Return to the poems, study notes, verse exploration and traveller’s guide in the top bar. | Then gather what you have seen and felt in the learning journal, and make this journey your own.
